title: Mina and the Missing Shoe
subtitle: A four-minute morning storm
description: The front door felt a thousand footsteps away - and the bus was due in four minutes. A missing shoe, a sharp sentence and one small choice turn the morning rush into a story about keeping the deadline without making Mina the problem. The final page gives parents, carers and educators a key message and practical ideas for shared discussion and rehearsal.
